info.title: Payment Methods
info.description: The Payment Methods API allows you to manage your payment methods.  You can add, delete, and set default payment methods.

post.description: This endpoint is used to generate a unique URL to embed into your application using an iFrame. End users will use this to provide their credit card information, which can be used in the /credit-card/charge endpoint.

ClientAccountID.description: When provided, the credit card added will be attached to the Client Account ID

RedirectURL.description: URL to redirect the user to after a credit card is added.

RedirectMethod.description: This parameter accepts InnerRedirect, OuterRedirect, and JavascriptMessage as parameter values.

ClientControlled.description: When set to true, the credit card added will be linked to your VoPay account. Default is false.

CardTypeValidation.description: When set to true, the card type will be validated to ensure the entered information represents a credit card. Default is false.

post.description: This endpoint is used to generate a unique URL to embed into your application using an iFrame. End users will use this to log in to their online banking and select a bank account to make a payment from. For additional details on iQ11 and RedirectMethod, please visit our [Iq11 Overview](https://docs.vopay.com/docs/iq11-overview)

ClientAccountID.description: When provided, the bank account submitted will be attached to the Client Account ID

RedirectURL.description: URL to redirect to after the customer logs in to their online banking account. The bank account token will be passed as a GET parameter, for example https://redirect.com/page?Token=1234

Language.description: Language of iQ11 iFrame- en (English) or fr (French). Default value is en (English)

RedirectMethod.description: This parameter accepts InnerRedirect, OuterRedirect, and JavascriptMessage as parameter values.

AccountSelectionMethod.description: This parameter accepts any, online and manual as parameter values. Defaults to any.

ClientControlled.description: When set to true, the connected bank account will be linked to your VoPay account. Default is false.

ClientReferenceNumber.description: An optional reference number to associate with the bank account.

TermsAndConditions.description: Used to add your own terms and conditions

Country.description: This parameter accepts country codes [CA, US]. Default is CA

WithTransactions.description: Request transaction history when connecting a bank account online. Default is false.

RequireDebitAuthorityAgreement.description: This parameter will determine if we display a debit authority agreement to the end-user before the connect their payment method. You must request this feature to be enabled for your account. Default is true.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

IframeKey.description: Unique key attached to the generated iFrame

post.description:
This endpoint allows you to identify a bank account as belonging to the VoPay account holder.

 Optionally, you can use this endpoint to identify a bank account as being the VoPay account holder's default operational and/or billing bank account. The VoPay account holder's default operational bank account is used in the /account/fund-my-account and /account/withdraw-my-account endpoints. The VoPay account holder's default billing bank account is used to collect monthly invoices. Note, a VoPay account can only have one default operational and one default billing bank account per currency.

SetAsDefault.description: Identify bank account as a default bank account

Purpose.description: Identify bank account purpose. Input can be a comma-delimited list. Valid values are: operational and billing. Default value is operational.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to add an Interac email to your VoPay account. Optionally, you can use this enpoint to also set the email as default for the VoPay account.

RecipientName.description: The name of the recipient associated with this email

RecipientEmailAddress.description: The Email address to be associated with the account.

RecipientPhoneNumber.description: The Phone number to be associated with the account.

Currency.description: 3 character currency code. If this is not specified the email will use the account's local currency (CAD).

Question.description: Security question for this email address.

Answer.description: Answer to the security question. This can be either a plain text answer or a hashed answer. Hashed answers must have leading and trailing whitespace trimmed, be SHA2 hashed and Base64 encoded. If a hashed answer is provided, the HashSalt input is mandatory.

Message.description: An optional message to associate with the email address.

Language.description: Recipient's language preference. Accepted values: en (English as the default) or fr (French).

ClientReferenceNumber.description: An optional reference number to associate with the transactions

ClientControlled.description: When set to true, the connected email will be linked to your VoPay account. Default is false.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

Token.description: The token associated with the email record

Optionally, you can use this endpoint to identify a Apple Pay credit card as being the VoPay account holder's default Apple Pay credit card. Note, a VoPay account can only have one default Apple Pay credit card.

SetAsDefault.description: Identify credit card as default Apple Pay credit card

Success.description: true if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

IsDefault.description: Is this the VoPay account holder's default Apple Pay credit card

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the default Apple Pay credit card associated with your VoPay account

parameters.name: ClientAccountID
parameters.description: When provided, this endpoint will return the default Apple Pay credit card associated with this Client Account ID

Success.description: true if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

DefaultCreditCard.description: Array serialized as a JSON object (JSON_FORCE_OBJECT): numeric string keys '0','1',... Empty {} when no items. Default Apple Pay credit card associated with the Account or Client Account

ApplePayToken.description: A unique token associated with the credit card.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to add a PayPal account to your VoPay account

ContactID.description: The ID of the contact to use for this PayPal account.

PayPalRecipientType.description: The type of the PayPal account identifier. Valid values are 'EMAIL', 'PHONE', 'PAYPAL_ID'.

RecipientID.description: The recipient ID (email address, phone number, or PayPal ID) of the PayPal account. This value corresponds with the PayPalRecipientType value in the request.

RecipientName.description: The full name of the PayPal account holder.

Currency.description: 3 character currency code for the currency to be charged to the customer's PayPal wallet. If this is not specified the transaction will use the account's local currency.

Success.description: true if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

post.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a PayPal account from your VoPay account

PayPalToken.description: The Token associated with the PayPal account you wish to delete.

Success.description: true if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

get.description: This endpoint allows you fetch a list all of your PayPal recipients

parameters.name: ClientControlled
parameters.description: When set to true, this endpoint will only return PayPal accounts linked to your VoPay account. When set to false, it will return a list of your customer's PayPal accounts.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Limit the number of records that are returned.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the starting point in the dataset.

Success.description: true if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

PaypalRecipients.description: Array serialized as a JSON object (JSON_FORCE_OBJECT): numeric string keys '0','1',... Empty {} when no items. A collection of PayPal recipients

RecipientID.description: The email address, phone number, or PayPal ID.

PayPalToken.description: The Token associated with the recipient

ClientControlledPayPalAccount.description: Set to 1 if the PayPal recipient is linked to your VoPay account.

IsDefault.description: Set to 1 if the PayPal recipient is the default

post.description: Initiate a Zelle B2C payment to a recipient identified by email address or mobile phone number.

EmailAddress.description: Recipient's email address used as their Zelle alias. Either EmailAddress or PhoneNumber must be provided.

PhoneNumber.description: Recipient's mobile phone number used as their Zelle alias. Either EmailAddress or PhoneNumber must be provided.

PriorityType.description: Payment priority. Accepted values: STANDARD, INSTANT. Defaults to the account's configured priority type.

Notes.description: Optional memo or note for the payment

ClientAccountID.description: Client Account ID to associate with this transaction

ClientReferenceNumber.description: An optional reference number to associate with this transaction

IdempotencyKey.description: A unique key to prevent duplicate transactions

GLCode.description: General ledger code for the transaction

ParentTransactionID.description: ID of a parent pre-funding transaction to link to this payment

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

TransactionID.description: Unique identifier for the created Zelle transaction

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific Zelle withdrawal transaction.

parameters.name: TransactionID
parameters.description: The ID of the Zelle transaction to retrieve

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

TransactionDate.description: Date and time the transaction was created

Amount.description: Transaction amount formatted to 2 decimal places

RecipientPhone.description: Recipient's mobile phone alias, if used

Notes.description: Memo or note associated with the payment

ClientReferenceNumber.description: Client reference number associated with the transaction

LastModified.description: Date and time the transaction was last modified

get.description: List Zelle withdrawal transactions for the account within a specified date range.

parameters.name: StartDateTime
parameters.description: Start of the date range to filter transactions (e.g. 2024-01-01 or 2024-01-01 00:00:00)

parameters.name: EndDateTime
parameters.description: End of the date range to filter transactions (e.g. 2024-01-31 or 2024-01-31 23:59:59)

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

ZelleTransactions.description: Array serialized as a JSON object (JSON_FORCE_OBJECT): numeric string keys '0','1',... Empty {} when no items. Collection of Zelle withdrawal transactions

TransactionDateTime.description: Date and time the transaction was created

Amount.description: Transaction amount formatted to 2 decimal places

RecipientPhone.description: Recipient's mobile phone alias, if used

Notes.description: Memo or note associated with the payment

LastModified.description: Date and time the transaction was last modified

post.description: Cancel a pending Zelle withdrawal transaction. If the transaction has already been submitted to the processor, a cancellation request will be sent.

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

post.description: Approve or reject a Zelle payment that is pending name match verification. When the recipient's registered name does not match the name provided, the payment is held for manual review.
